Figure 4. Double pulsed ¢eld gradient spin
echo-selective TOCSY of 6 (C6D6)
produced from 10(b) and of unlabeled 6(a).
The H5 signal at N5.38 was selectively
excited in each case followed by a 65 ms
mixing period. The predominant signals
following the mixing period are those of
the C-ring. Note the presence of the 7K
proton signal in a at N1.76 but its absence
in b following deuterium atom transfer.
Other features to note are the collapse of
the 7L, 6K, and 6L proton ¢ne structure in
b as compared with a.
